title: Support Reply Rewriter
summary: Build a small local-first rewrite flow that turns one rough support draft into a cleaner reply.
done_definition: Done when one rough message can be pasted in, rewritten locally, and copied back out.
next_tiny_action: Open readme-draft.md and define the single input, rewrite button, and output panel.
plan_steps: Limit the tool to one input box, one rewrite action, and one output area.
Write deterministic rewrite templates and connect them to the local flow.
Test the same sample message twice and confirm the output stays stable.
